2607.05260.title: Shifting from Discrete to Continuous Reference Data: QSM-Derived Horizontal Tree Biomass Distribution for Deep Learning Biomass Estimation
2607.05260.paper_summary: Conventional modeling approaches for LiDAR-based above-ground biomass (AGB) estimation rely on discrete plot-level inventory aggregates. This methodology introduces boundary-effect uncertainties that may severely degrade model performance within small field plots. To solve this limitation, we evaluate a Horizontal Biomass Distribution (HBD) reference mapped continuously from Quantitative Structure Models (QSMs). We trained a sparse 3D U-Net on simulated broadleaved forest structures using three AGB reference types: a standard forest inventory (FI) plot-level aggregate, an edge-effect-free QSM plot-level aggregate, and a continuous HBD mapping. Evaluating training plot sizes scaling from 100 to 2500 $m^2$ , QSM-based models systematically outperformed FI approaches at small plot sizes. Specifically, for 100 $m^2$ plots, the HBD reference reduced the relative root mean square error (RRMSE) by 16.84 $\pm$ 4.37 % and increased $R^2$ by 0.22 $\pm$ 0.05 against the FI baseline. By replacing plot level aggregates with HBDs as AGB reference, this methodology corrects for edge-effects and shows that using an HBD-based reference enhances model performance for small plot sizes.
2607.05260.paper_summary_zh: 傳統的基於LiDAR的地上生物量（AGB）估算建模方法依賴於離散的樣區級庫存總和。這種方法引入了邊界效應的不確定性，可能會嚴重降低小樣區的模型性能。為了解決這一限制，我們評估了一種從定量結構模型（QSMs）持續映射的水平生物量分佈（HBD）參考。我們在模擬的闊葉林結構上訓練了一個稀疏的3D U-Net，使用三種AGB參考類型：標準森林庫存（FI）樣區級總和、無邊界效應的QSM樣區級總和和連續的HBD映射。評估樣區面積從100到2500 $m^2$ 的縮放，基於QSM的模型在小樣區面積上系統性地超越了FI方法。具體而言，對於100 $m^2$ 的樣區，HBD參考將相對均方根誤差（RRMSE）降低了16.84 $\pm$ 4.37 %，並將$R^2$提高了0.22 $\pm$ 0.05，相對於FI基準。通過用HBD替代樣區級總和作為AGB參考，這種方法修正了邊界效應，並顯示使用基於HBD的參考可以提高小樣區的模型性能。
